VERDICT_ONE_LINE: There is one genuinely admissible mechanism and the director found it: a cross-sectional event book on SEC staff comment letters (EDGAR form UPLOAD), whose full four-part key REGULATORY_SCRUTINY|SEC_COMMENT_LETTER|US_EQUITY|XS_EVENT_BOOK returns NO_ROW_IN_MEMORY and whose bytes have provably never been ingested (configs/alpha_agent/stage2_ingestion.json:118 lists eight forms and neither UPLOAD nor CORRESP is among them). It is also the first candidate in three campaigns whose free public source actually keeps an archive - probed live, HTTP 200 with 2,136 to 3,484 UPLOAD rows per quarter from 2012Q1 - which is why it does not die the HISTORY_FLOOR death that killed the Nasdaq halt feed and the ALFRED vintages. It is nevertheless NOT pre-registered today, because the director measured a blocking defect in his own proposal before scoring anything: the EDGAR CIK bridges 656 of 661 still-listed panel symbols (99.24%) and ZERO of the 1,236 delisted ones, and those delisted names are 65.2% of sp500_pit_panel_v1. Comment letters concentrate on filers with contested accounting and those filers delist at an elevated rate, so the unobservable two thirds of the panel is selected in exactly the direction of the hypothesis. A book built on today's survivors would not be a weaker test of this mechanism; it would be a test of a different one.
WHAT_IS_BEING_HANDED_BACK: ONE cell, not a menu, with its pre-registration withheld and one bounded $0 certification commissioned to decide it. If D1 clears the bridge, the cell registers as specified with no parameter changed. If D1 cannot, the campaign returns NULL_ON_DATA and the acquisition proposal below is the operator's decision.

MECHANISM_KEYS_AND_CHECK_MECHANISM_VERDI.owner: alpha_agent.r59.memory.mechanism_state via scripts/alpha_agents_v2.py check-mechanism (read-only, runs nothing)
MECHANISM_KEYS_AND_CHECK_MECHANISM_VERDI.HOW_THE_DIRECTOR_RULES_ON_THAT_TENSION: Six adverse probes return SETTLED_DO_NOT_REPEAT and the ruling states them before it states its own answer. The task's rule 4 draws the line and the director applies it in both directions. Duplicate SOURCE: admitted, EDGAR carries six settled information families. Duplicate ECONOMIC MECHANISM: no - every settled EDGAR mechanism reads an object the ISSUER authored and timed (filing cadence, disclosure volume, 8-K item choice, XBRL numbers, holder filings), whereas a comment letter is authored by the regulator ABOUT the issuer, is adversarial, and is timed by the SEC. Genuinely NEW INFORMATION CHANNEL: yes, and the evidence is a file and a line rather than an argument - forms_of_interest at configs/alpha_agent/stage2_ingestion.json:118 is exactly ["8-K","8-K/A","10-Q","10-Q/A","10-K","10-K/A","4","4/A"], and a repo-wide grep for UPLOAD and CORRESP across every .py returns only the unrelated constant NO_RESTRICTED_DATA_UPLOAD in alpha_agent/r40/contract.py:171 and alpha_agent/r40/open_models.py:6,271.
MECHANISM_KEYS_AND_CHECK_MECHANISM_VERDI.THE_TEST_THE_DIRECTOR_DID_NOT_DODGE: R67's V2 ruling refused XA_TERMS_OF_TRADE because its feature was built entirely from RETURNS - the same input bytes already prosecuted, relabelled into an unused information_family to reach a burden-0 key. That test is the right one and it is applied here rather than avoided. It acquits this cell only because the input bytes are a form type that has never been read and cannot be derived from any prosecuted input. Had the candidate been a recomputation over already-ingested EDGAR objects, it would have been refused on exactly R67's grounds.
MECHANISM_KEYS_AND_CHECK_MECHANISM_VERDI.BURDEN_CONSEQUENCE_ACCEPTED_NOT_ARGUED_A: Because the conservative reading (this is FILING_EVENT reopened on NEW_ORTHOGONAL_INFORMATION) is arguable, the cell is budgeted at a denominator of 4, not 1. Per the R68 correction, a reopened mechanism inherits its parent's denominator and may never be charged to a fresh key. If alpha_agent.r59.handlers.search_denominator returns a larger number at registration, the larger number governs; a director may raise his own burden and may not lower it.

NULL_BRANCH_AND_THE_ONE_ACQUISITION_PROP.when_this_branch_binds: If R76_D1 returns NOT_CERTIFIABLE on DELISTED_BRIDGE_COVERAGE - which is the outcome the director expects on owned data, since the measured figure today is 0.00 - the campaign result is NULL_ON_DATA and this is the single proposal that follows. Nothing is purchased by this ruling. The operator decides.
NULL_BRANCH_AND_THE_ONE_ACQUISITION_PROP.exact_dataset: WRDS CRSP/Compustat Merged - the CCM Linking Table (CRSP PERMNO <-> Compustat GVKEY, with linktype, linkprim and the LINKDT/LINKENDDT effective-date range) together with the Compustat Company file field CIK and the CRSP stocknames / dsenames file (PERMNO <-> TICKER <-> CUSIP with effective dates). The three together are the only widely-used construction that carries a HISTORICAL, date-effective CIK <-> ticker mapping including dead registrants.
NULL_BRANCH_AND_THE_ONE_ACQUISITION_PROP.provider: Wharton Research Data Services (WRDS), University of Pennsylvania. Underlying data from CRSP (University of Chicago Booth) and S&P Global Market Intelligence (Compustat).
NULL_BRANCH_AND_THE_ONE_ACQUISITION_PROP.entitlement_required: An institutional WRDS subscription with the CRSP/Compustat Merged product entitled. WRDS does not sell to individuals; access is via an institutional account. This is a HARD entitlement obstacle and is stated first rather than buried.
NULL_BRANCH_AND_THE_ONE_ACQUISITION_PROP.historical_pit_coverage: CCM link records are date-effective (LINKDT/LINKENDDT), so the mapping as-known-on-a-date is reconstructible - genuine point-in-time identity, not a latest-state snapshot. CRSP dsenames carries NAMEDT/NAMEENDDT for ticker changes. Coverage of the required 2012-2026 window is complete.
NULL_BRANCH_AND_THE_ONE_ACQUISITION_PROP.inactive_delisted_coverage: This is the entire reason for the proposal. CRSP retains every delisted security with its delisting date and delisting return; PERMNO is never recycled, unlike a ticker. This is what would take the delisted bridge rate from the measured 0.00 toward the frozen 0.85 threshold and let a false-match rate be measured against a permanent identifier rather than asserted.
NULL_BRANCH_AND_THE_ONE_ACQUISITION_PROP.obtainable_price_or_quote_requirement: NOT OBTAINABLE AS A LIST PRICE, and the director will not invent one. WRDS is quoted per institution and is not published. A QUOTE IS REQUIRED and only a human can request it. Publicly observable order of magnitude is institutional-scale annual subscription; the director has no artifact stating a number and therefore states none.
NULL_BRANCH_AND_THE_ONE_ACQUISITION_PROP.exact_candidate_mechanism_it_unlocks: REGULATORY_SCRUTINY|SEC_COMMENT_LETTER|US_EQUITY|XS_EVENT_BOOK, fully specified in campaign_spec.json#CANDIDATE with its horizon (63 sessions), cadence (21), expression (LONG_SHORT dollar-neutral), expected sign (-1 on the letter-bearing leg), primary statistic (Newey-West lockbox t), threshold (|t| >= 3.00 post-BH), burden denominator (4) and six failure conditions - all frozen BEFORE the data exists, so the purchase cannot be justified retroactively by a result.
NULL_BRANCH_AND_THE_ONE_ACQUISITION_PROP.why_owned_data_cannot_answer_the_same_qu: The measurement is in this ruling: company_tickers.json bridges 0 of 1,236 delisted panel symbols, and 65.2% of the panel is delisted. The only free alternative, name matching against sec.gov/Archives/edgar/cik-lookup-data.txt, is the exact unaudited issuer-name bridge the R60 census cites as the reason us_equity_extension_pit_panel_v1 is frozen; adopting it here would reproduce a known defect rather than remove one. Restricting to the 661 surviving names is not a mitigation, it is the survivorship bias written into the universe definition.
